title: Clearer privacy choices and better discovery
body:
PRIVACY SETTINGS, WITHIN REACH
- Find Privacy settings in the More menu, mobile navigation, footer, and Cookie Policy, including while playing fullscreen games.
- The control opens Google's privacy message when its consent service is available. If it is unavailable, we explain that no choices were changed.
- Removed the old local cookie banner; its saved choice is not treated as advertising consent.

CLEARER ADVERTISING INFORMATION
- Updated the Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, and Terms to describe advertising and privacy choices more accurately.
- Removed a duplicate advertising script so the configured AdSense integration has a single loader.

BETTER PUBLIC DISCOVERY
- Each page now identifies its own canonical address instead of pointing every route at the homepage.
- The public sitemap now follows the live blog database and current public pages, including all nine daily games, friend play, and patch notes. Future-dated blog records are excluded.

These changes prepare the site for Google's privacy messaging and review. They do not themselves publish a consent message or guarantee AdSense approval.
